facts.text: To earn a Bachelor of Fine Arts degree in Illustration, students must complete 120 credits, including 72 credits in studio art courses and 30 credits in humanities and sciences courses.

sources.title: BFA Illustration Curriculum | School of Visual Arts | SVA NYC
sources.quote: To earn a Bachelor of Fine Arts degree in Illustration at SVA, students must complete 120 credits as follows: 72 credits in studio art courses 30 credits in humanities & sciences courses
